text: 1. Certificate of HSK For applicants of Chinese Language major and Chinese Language and Culture major:Level 3 or above. For those applying to take classes with Chinese students: HSK Level 6 or above 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Certificate/diploma of highest education Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Academic transcript of highest education Original transcript of academic record. 6. Valid identity document of the applicant's emergency contact person A photocopy of the ID of the emergency contact (can be a license, official ID of Chinese citizen or foreigner). 7. Letter of recommendation Reference letter from applicants' former teacher.
